AI knowledge base for staff

New staff get answers from your rules and manuals in a minute, with the source document, instead of asking a manager. An MVP in 3–6 weeks, from UZS 48 mln; the full version in 8–14 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Up to a few hundred documents (PDF, Word, Google Docs)
  • Answers in Uzbek and Russian with links to the source
  • Access through Telegram or the web
  • Admin uploads new documents
What the full version adds
  • Role-based access, so staff see only what they may
  • Sync with Google Drive or SharePoint
  • Answer review and feedback
  • Onboarding quizzes
  • List of unanswered questions to improve the documents
Please note

Can run on servers in Uzbekistan with a self-hosted model when documents must not leave the country.

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results

Questions

How long does “AI knowledge base for staff” take?
